description: This file defines the AttributeKvRepository interface for accessing attribute key-value entities in a SQL database, including custom queries for retrieving, deleting, and batching attribute data, as well as projections for latest attribute entries.

classes.name: AttributeKvRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for AttributeKvEntity with custom SQL queries for attribute data management.

classes.name: AttributeKvProjection
classes.description: Projection interface for retrieving latest attribute key-value entries with a static method to convert to AttributeKvEntry.

methods.name: findAllByEntityIdAndAttributeType
methods.description: Finds all AttributeKvEntity records matching a specific entity ID and attribute type.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an AttributeKvEntity record based on entity ID, attribute type, and attribute key.

methods.name: findAllKeysByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves distinct attribute keys for devices under a specific tenant and device profile.

methods.name: findAllKeysByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves distinct attribute keys for devices under a specific tenant.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves distinct attribute keys for a list of entity IDs.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAndAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves distinct attribute keys for a list of entity IDs filtered by attribute type.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAndAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves latest attribute key-value projections for given entity IDs and attribute type.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of AttributeKvEntity records after specified entity ID, attribute type, and key.
